entities.summary: Philip Sulumeti was a Kenyan prelate of the Catholic Church who served as the Bishop Emeritus of the Diocese of Kakamega from 5 December 2014 until his death. He had served as the ordinary of the Diocese of Kakamega since his appointment as its founding bishop on 28 February 1978. Before that, he had been the ordinary of the Diocese of Kisumu from 1976 until 1978, when he was transferred to Kakamega. He also served as the Auxiliary Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Kisumu from 1972 until 1976. He retired on 5 December 2014.
